Our story

From our hands,
to your everyday.

Meet Sanaa Sleem & Evana Hassanieh, the hands behind The Wooden Knots.

Two makers. One shared thread.

A thread
worth following.

Established in 2022, The Wooden Knots is a macrame project by Sanaa Sleem and Evana Hassanieh. Working from Boqaata Jdaideh in the Shouf, the makers explore the possibilities of knotting through pieces for the home and small gifts.

The photographs bring that range together: layered leaves, geometric wall pieces, fringed mirrors, cushions and bags. Find a piece that speaks to you, save the photograph, then talk with the makers about the details.

Made in Boqaata Jdaideh, Shouf, Lebanon.

Atelier visits are by appointment. Please call to arrange a time.
